answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent grows one reef of attested tasks over time, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. A karst trail of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once, keeping the horizon of trusted standing open only to histories that can be checked.
